title: CI remove unused redis_docs_sync workflow
body:
Failed CI: https://github.com/redis/redis/actions/runs/35238102244/job/105259152210

This CI keeps failing and is no longer needed, so we can delete it.   




<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Only deletes a CI workflow; no runtime or application code changes, though docs may no longer auto-sync from this repository on release unless handled elsewhere.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Removes** the `redis_docs_sync` GitHub Actions workflow that ran on **release published** events for `redis/redis`.
> 
> That job generated a docs GitHub App token and, when the published tag matched the latest release, dispatched `redis_docs_sync.yaml` in **redis/docs**. With this PR, releases in this repo no longer trigger that automated docs sync from here.
>
